title: The Core of Corruption
summary: The heroes track Varth to Eriadu — Moff Tarkin's seat of power — and infiltrate his Citadel to learn the truth. Through the Glass Bridge, they witness Varth receive command of Leviathan from Tarkin himself. They must slice the Primary Data Center for Varth's transit orders while fighting Death Troopers and Draco's Apprentice, then escape through the acid rain of Eriadu's industrial hellscape.

marks.label: Tarkin's World
marks.desc: Reach Eriadu and navigate the most heavily Imperial world in the Outer Rim.

marks.label: The Citadel
marks.desc: Infiltrate Tarkin's Citadel — the seat of power for the entire Outer Rim.

marks.label: The Glass Bridge
marks.desc: Witness the truth through the Glass Bridge. What you see changes everything.

marks.label: The Primary Data Center
marks.desc: Slice into the PDC and extract Varth's transit orders. The clock is ticking.

marks.label: The Apprentice
marks.desc: Face Draco's Apprentice in the corridors of the Citadel.

marks.label: The Hellscape
marks.desc: Escape through Eriadu's industrial acid rain. The planet itself is hostile.

marks.label: The Crucible
marks.desc: The plan catastrophically fails. Improvise under fire to survive.

gearNotes.reason: Coordinating a multi-pronged assault on an Imperial depot. Imperial signals intelligence will intercept open comms instantly.
Military-grade locks on depot doors, armories, and control rooms. Multiple breach points during the raid.
Sabotaging depot systems, disabling automated defenses, rigging demolition charges.
Commando raid with guaranteed casualties. No medevac available during the assault.
The escape likely requires ship repair under fire during the fallout. Getting off-world after kicking the hornet's nest.
Pre-raid reconnaissance of the depot layout, guard rotations, and defense positions. The Briefing scene is where this pays off.
Breaching reinforced depot walls and doors. Backup entry method if the Security Kit is too slow under fire.
Imperial supply depots have automated defenses and security droids. Possibly AT-ST walkers in the motor pool.
Demolition and area denial. A supply depot raid is the textbook use case for ordnance.
Assault cover during approach and extraction. Controlling sightlines against entrenched defenders.
Avoiding depot sensor arrays and perimeter detection during the approach phase.
Quick-bypassing depot terminals to disable security systems or access inventory manifests.
Post-raid trauma recovery during the Fallout escape sequence.

encounters.name: Beat 1 — Picking Up Varth's Trail
encounters.trigger: Crew arrives at Eriadu after the adv5 break
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: Eriadu arrival beat. The crew is hunting Varth post-betrayal — this is the beat where they confirm he is on Eriadu and pick up his ground-trail. The varth-leviathan conversation (adv10-p2-s3) references this entire arc; the build-out should make the betrayal's aftermath emotionally weighty. Full readAloud/gmNotes pending adv6 build-out (see follow-up #144).

encounters.name: Beat 2 — Eriadu Broker Sit-Down
encounters.trigger: Crew makes contact with the Eriadu fixer
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: Major sit-down NPC for adv6 to be named in build-out. Reserve a conversation overlay slot. The fixer should know enough to point the crew at Draco's citadel and at Varth's data-center target.
encounters.tactics: GM ACTION (when adv6 is built out): Launch the fixer's conversation overlay. Comfort starting value to be set in the build-out pass.

encounters.name: Beat 3 — Sighting the Citadel
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: Visual sighting and reconnaissance handoff to s2 (Reconnaissance of the Citadel). Establish the citadel's scale, the acid rain weather, the security posture. To be expanded.

encounters.name: Beat 1 — Boarding the Banshee Without Varth
encounters.trigger: Crew makes the Banshee after the citadel escape
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The first quiet moment after the betrayal. Maya is at the controls. Denia is in the medbay. Varth is gone. The crew sits in the common room with what just happened. This beat is the emotional pivot of the campaign — it should be played slow, in quiet. Full readAloud and a Maya conversation overlay opportunity to be authored in the adv6 build-out pass.
encounters.tactics: NO DICE — emotional pivot. Reserve a Maya conversation overlay slot here — the Banshee galley scene format from adv1 should be re-used for a "Maya post-betrayal" conversation that mirrors the original galley scene's warmth with grief instead.

encounters.name: Beat 2 — The Jump Off Eriadu
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: Imperial pursuit / hyperspace jump beat. The Banshee threads the upper atmosphere under fire and jumps to the rendezvous coordinates Varth-the-traitor would NOT know about (Maya's personal cache).
encounters.tactics: RUN tactical pursuit checks — placeholder for build-out pass.

encounters.name: Beat 3 — A Quiet Night in Hyperspace
encounters.description: SCAFFOLD: The crew's first real conversation about what just happened. This is the second Maya-overlay opportunity — paired with Beat 1, it bookends the betrayal with grief and resolve. To be authored in build-out.
encounters.tactics: NO DICE — closing tonal beat scaffold. Reserve conversation slot.
